# bugs #2221: mov psw is removed from an interrupt routine that selects a register bank and calls a function

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/2221/
- Category: [Already fixed in trunk](../../fixed-upstream.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close as fixed in r8862 and, for the recurrence of 2018, in r11638.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The ticket contains two reports. According to the description of 2012, `genEndFunction` removes the
`mov psw,#0x08` of an interrupt routine declared with `__using(1)` when the routine uses no
register itself and calls a function that does. In 2018 a maintainer reopened the ticket and quoted
the line `genFromRTrack removed mov psw,#0x08` from the assembly output.

Neither occurs on r17176. A test file with two interrupt routines, both declared `__interrupt` and
`__using(1)`, was compiled for mcs51 and run in ucsim. Neither routine uses a register, and each
calls a `__using(1)` function. In the small model the function that each routine interrupts keeps
an operand in `r7` across the interrupt. The file was compiled with the small, medium, large, and
huge models, with `--stack-auto` for small and large, with `--opt-code-size`, and with
`--fverbose-asm`. In every case both routines contain `push psw` followed by `mov psw,#0x08`, and
the results of the four functions are correct.

## Fixed by

[r8862](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/8862/) applied the patch of the ticket for the report of
2012. `genEndFunction` in `src/mcs51/gen.c` keeps the instruction when `IFFUNC_HASFCALL` is true for
the function. The ticket names r8863, which only renames the test file.

[r11638](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/11638/) removed the cause of the report of 2018,
although its ChangeLog entry does not mention it. Before r11638 the `CND` entry of `regs8051` in
`src/mcs51/ralloc.c` had the `dname` `psw`, and `regidxfromregname` in `src/mcs51/rtrack.c` matched
the destination of `mov psw,#0x08` with that entry. `_mcs51_rtrackUpdate` therefore treated the
instruction as the load of a register whose value it tracks. With `--fverbose-asm` it removed the
instruction when its record for the entry already contained 0x08, and it wrote the message that the
maintainer quoted. r11638 changed the `dname` to `not_psw`, so the destination matches no entry and
the instruction is handled by the branch for `mov psw,`, which keeps the line and invalidates the
records of `r0` to `r7`. In r17176 `mcs51_regname_to_idx` compares whole register names, and `psw`
is not one of them.

This explanation comes from reading the two revisions. No revision before r11638 was built, and the
instruction sequence that set the record to 0x08 in the maintainer's case was not determined.

## Related

The body of `testBug` in `support/regression/tests/bug-2221.c` is inside `#if 0` since r10167. The
regression suite therefore compiles the functions of the test for mcs51 and does not run them.
